scientific_integrity: Existence of onto-word universal cycles is credited to established work; the new claim is exact labeled and symmetry-quotient enumeration. A complete mathematical proof and independent finite exhaustive cross-check are included.
scientific_limitations: The finite classification concerns only alphabet size 3, ordinary surjective four-letter windows, and rotations/relabelings/reversals as separately defined; it does not extend to arbitrary alphabet sizes or spans. Priority remains contingent on possibly unindexed equivalent literature.
title: Exact symmetry classes of ternary onto-word universal cycles of span four
